description:
Kids all over grow up riding bikes. Riding to the park, riding to the river, riding to get ice cream, riding just for the fun of it. This bike is your bike from childhood, all grown up, mostly.
The Shred to Ed's is our Big Kid BMX bike, named for our local trailside liquor store and our tendency to ride our bikes there in a spirited manner. It's designed for ripping around town, riding cutty trails, and occasionally stopping for snacks and refreshment. It's also an especially great bike for watching sunsets and cruising home after dark on warm summer nights. Riding bikes is a fun way to spend a day, and this bike is a fun one to ride the heck out of.
